content.title: The New York Times
content.text: “One Battle After Another” won best picture at the Oscars on Sunday night, completing a dominant awards-season run. The movie also won Academy Awards for best director for Paul Thomas Anderson, supporting actor for Sean Penn, adapted screenplay, editing and casting. https://nyti.ms/4uxfn5kAll reactions:Tamara MichelleI love that art is subjective and everyone can have different takeaways from the same material. I watched this movie once and I'll never watch it again in my life. I've watched Sinners 2x at the movies and at least 4x at home and will continue to watch it. We're all moved by something different. It's art.42Robin SchafferI enjoyed the movie. It was sometime shocking, sometimes poignant and occasionally funny. A stoner trying to remember a password from 15 years before was hilarious.38Aaron FilyawProbably the best BEST picture win since Parasite. With apologies to Oppenheimer. A terrific win for a superb filmmaker.Alex KrislovI had to agree with the awards. "Sinners" was great fun, but not really very original, even for a vampire flick. Amazing music, mind you. "One Battle After Another" was original, unpredictable and supremely funny.23Gunter NobisLeonardo is like, WTH am I doing here ??10Tracey Lloyd EverettIf anyone else says that Sinners was just a vampire flick, I'm going to lose my mind81Collette OjedaLame.
